g.text: • Pooling helps the network with the smaller meta-sample: +0.013 NSE in Indonesia over the region-only gate (p ≤ 0.005), and is neutral in Australia
• Zero-shot transfer: a gate that never saw the target network still beats its local gates at short horizons (p < 0.001 in Indonesia, 0.020 in Australia)
• Accuracy on held-out stations rises with the number of pooled stations and levels off at about eight
• Pooling makes up for two missing regional indices: the 3-index joint gate matches the 6-index regional gate
